CONFLICT_LATTICE.decision: which rival scales T1 compares (pre-1.2.0 evidence only)

ISOTROPY.decision: ISOTROPY corroboration of a LATTICE reading

LATTICE.decision: which LATTICE scales are tried (pre-1.2.0 evidence only)

RANKING.decision: compareReadings / evidenceTuple / drawingTuple key, challenge drawingChoice, REFUSED vs KEPT

T3_ACCUSE.decision: OUTER_TOTALS: long readings agreeing on another scale

T3_DEFEND.decision: OUTER_TOTALS: long length agreeing with the registration

contested: |K| >= 2, K = {TOKEN, LATTICE CLEAR/SUPPORTED, EXTERNAL corroborating}; uncontested statements are FROZEN under every mode
dag: T1_REG,T1_ALT,T3_* -> sourceConflictOf -> sourceConflictFor -> reconstruct-v2 :278 (early, footprint-only) / :330 (late) -> challengeFirstReading({conflict})

RANKING -> scoreReading.refutedShare -> compareReadings / evidenceTuple (resolvePlan) and drawingTuple / drawingChoice (challengeFirstReading) -> RESOLVED/REPLACED/REFUSED/KEPT -> selected copy, scale, layout
LATTICE -> resolvePlan/challenge decompositions (scale alternatives); ISOTROPY -> corroborations -> acceptable()
statementsOn.firstReadCm -> metricsAtScale re-read options (C6, frozen) -> layout values at another scale

callSites: plan-resolution.ts:330 metricsAtScale options = firstReadCm then alternatives
C6_REREAD_OPTIONS.note: not an as-printed view consumer; frozen in every variant

C7_PARTIAL_BINDING.note: reads rawText, not the view; frozen in every variant

modes.KSET_ALL: the set; refutes a rival unless EVERY reading fits it; joins an accusation only if EVERY reading fits the accused scale
modes.KSET_ANY: the set of confident readings; refutes / fails to defend only if NO reading fits

noUnscopedCall: consumer-harness.mjs throws at setup if any zeroSubstitution(s)/zeroSubstitution(st)/asRead(s) call is left without a consumer, and every refutedShareAsRead call takes a required consumer argument; the generated copy is the frozen file plus exactly these edits (diff recorded in the report)
